decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (201212104-PL01 and Design and Access Statement received on 30/01/2013 and email titled 35-41 London Road 00707/35-41/P7, received at 11.36 on 10/04/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant (A3) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 12:00-23:00 Monday- Saturdays and 12:00-22:00 Sundays.

Condition : 4 - The A3 restaurant use hereby permitted shall not commence until full particulars and details of measures to suitably mitigate the transmission of odours and sound have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with such details.

Condition : 5 - The A3 restaurant use hereby permitted shall be confined to customers dining on the premises and shall not extend to the delivery of food and/or drink to customers by vehicle or to any takeaway service unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
description: Change of use of one unit (39-41) from existing retail (A1 use) to proposed restaurant (A3 use) and retain one unit for retail use (35-37) with the erection of an external air duct to the side elevation
